text:
Maya (CEO): Opening a day-after thread for the all-hands — quick clarifications on strategy and who owns follow-ups. Keep messages short.

Ravi (Solutions): For customer conversations, is the primary buying narrative performance/cost or compliance?

Maya (CEO): Both. For startups emphasize cost and deployment speed (hosted/dedicated). For regulated customers lead with Private + KMS + audit logs + SLAs.

Priya (Head of Product): Small ask: can we state a simple mission sentence for product pages?

Maya (CEO): Draft: "Make inference predictable, economical, and portable across any deployment." Priya feel free to shorten.

Jon (CTO): Reminder to engineering: demos should show observable metrics (latency, cost per 1k tokens) not just generated text.

Clara (Design): Marketing needs two short stat lines we can publish safely. Any approved numbers?

Maya (CEO): Use conservative benchmarks: "median latency 80ms for served decoder models (typical payloads), 40% cost reduction vs unmanaged GPU fleets." Tag these as illustrative until finance signs off.

InfraBot: Deployment report: canary rollout succeeded in eu-west-1 at 08:12 UTC.

Ravi (Solutions): Objection handling request: when prospects ask 'why not just use cloud GPUs', short answer?

Priya (Head of Product): "Cloud GPUs are fine, but you still need an inference stack to batch, cache, and route for predictable SLAs — that's what we provide"

Maya (CEO): Action items: Priya to post "winning metrics" doc, Jon to provide technical snippets for sales, Clara to draft marketing lines. I'll follow up with legal on publishable benchmarks.

Jon (CTO): Adding a YAML snippet we recommend for demos:
```nroute_policy:
  prefer: low_latency
  fallback: quantized_latency_optimized
  rollout: canary(5%)
```

Clara (Design): Thanks — will prepare hero copy and a one-liner for enterprise decks.

Maya (CEO): Great. If no more quick Qs, I'll close the thread by EOD and share the actions doc. :raised_hands:
